first_setup.command: ./starter setup (fresh tenant; GitHub; no browser on host)
includes: cold sidecar and publisher image downloads

timing_notes: Fresh setup includes both interactive browser sign-ins and cold sidecar/publisher downloads.
First up includes the first agent image build and both readiness waits. The publisher and sidecar images were pulled by setup.
The sum of fresh setup, first up and exercise is about 230 seconds; idle gaps between commands are excluded.
Host provisioning, candidate transfer, CLI installation and offline checks are outside these timings.
The host requires sudo docker. A temporary command outside the checkout used sudo --preserve-env=AAC_STARTER_UID,AAC_STARTER_GID /usr/bin/docker; containers ran as ssm-user (1001:1001).
The first offline check exposed missing UID/GID forwarding in that temporary sudo command; correcting it produced the recorded 75-pass result, with no candidate edits.
Standard CPU credits can throttle a t3.medium during sustained load. These are single-run observations, not performance guarantees.

teardown.note: Evidence retrieved and checksum verified before full destroy. Retained tag-index entries were checked against native terminated/NotFound results. Shared Terraform backend history remains.
